

WL-REQ-1781. `ns/ontology.ttl`: `wl:Review`, `wl:ReviewThread` as classes;
properties `wl:reviews` (domain `wl:Review`, range `wl:DesignDoc` or
`wl:Task`), `wl:reviewer`, `wl:threadIntent`, `wl:reviewVerdict`,
`wl:reviewRole`; and one `rdfs:subClassOf wl:Event` per WL-REQ-1780 event
(`wl:ReviewOpened`, `wl:ReviewRoundSubmitted`, `wl:ReviewQuestionAsked`,
`wl:ReviewQuestionAnswered`, `wl:ReviewThreadResolved`,
`wl:ReviewVerdictRecorded`, `wl:ReviewClosed`). `ns/concept.ttl`:
`wlc:ReviewIntent` (`note`, `change_request`, `question`) and
`wlc:ReviewVerdict` (`approved`, `changes_requested`), each concept spelling
its CHECK value. Then `./scripts/nsgen.py` regenerates `internal/ns/gen.go`,
and `internal/store/nsenums_test.go` gains the two scheme-to-constraint
pairs (`review_threads_intent_known`, `review_rounds_verdict_known`).

`internal/eventbus/vocab.go`: the seven `TypeReview*` constants and their
`payloadProperties`: `wl:reviewRole`, `wl:client`, `wl:focused`,
`wl:threadCount` for `ReviewRoundSubmitted`; `wl:threadIntent` for
`ReviewQuestionAsked`; `wl:threadStatus` for `ReviewThreadResolved`;
`wl:reviewVerdict` for `ReviewVerdictRecorded`; `wl:outcome` for
`ReviewClosed`. `vocab_test.go` holds the mirror.

- [ ] `riot --validate ns/*.ttl` — clean.
- [ ] `./scripts/nsgen.py && git diff --stat internal/ns/gen.go` — two new schemes.
- [ ] `go test -trimpath ./internal/ns ./internal/eventbus ./internal/store -run 'Scheme|Vocab|NsEnum' -count=1` — `ok`.
- [ ] Commit: `ns/: wl:Review, wl:ReviewThread, review events, ReviewIntent and ReviewVerdict schemes (WL-REQ-1781, WL-REQ-1780)`.
